instruction: Please create a new directory /var/webapp and create a user named "webadmin" with password "W3b@dm1n!" whose home directory is set to /var/webapp.

result.command: USERNAME="webadmin"; HOMEDIR="/var/webapp"; PASSWORD="W3b@dm1n!"; id "$USERNAME" &>/dev/null && ACTUAL_HOME=$(getent passwd "$USERNAME" | cut -d: -f6) && [ "$ACTUAL_HOME" = "$HOMEDIR" ] && [ -d "$HOMEDIR" ] && echo "$PASSWORD" | su -c "exit" "$USERNAME" 2>&1 | grep -q "^$" && echo 'User created with custom home directory and correct password' || echo 'Check failed'

include: User created with custom home directory and correct password

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating directory /var/webapp and user 'webadmin' with password 'W3b@dm1n!' and that custom home directory. Evaluator verifies user exists, home directory is set to /var/webapp via getent, directory exists, and password is set (verified by checking shadow file for non-empty password hash).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: directory creation, user creation, home directory assignment, and specific password
Command uses 'id "$USERNAME"' to verify user exists
Command uses 'getent passwd "$USERNAME" | cut -d: -f6' to extract actual home directory and compares it to expected '/var/webapp'
Command uses '[ -d "$HOMEDIR" ]' to verify directory exists
Command uses 'echo "$PASSWORD" | su -c "exit" "$USERNAME" 2>&1 | grep -q "^$"' to verify the SPECIFIC password 'W3b@dm1n!' works via authentication attempt
Logic flow is correct: all checks are chained with && so all must pass to return success message
Metric check_include_exclude correctly validates success/failure based on command output
Password verification is the only reliable way to check the specific password value (since shadow file stores hashes)
